value.rationale: The pentagonal torus is a canonical first odd-by-odd periodic two-dimensional grid. The exact mod-two three-degree homology and its natural landmark-puncture map identify a non-obvious phenomenon: reinstating one vertex kills 11 old degree-three classes and creates 12 new ones even though degree-three Betti rank changes only 85 to 86. This map is a motivated invariant not implied by extremal general-position numbers; it informs how higher topology of geodesic configurations depends on landmarks.
